 Monaco predicted XI v Le Mans: Folarin Balogun to drop to the bench? 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Folarin Balogun made his first start of the season in Thursday's 2-0 win over Nordsjaelland, but he is expected to return to the bench for Monaco's trip to Le Mans FC on Sunday afternoon, according to Get French Football News.
 Monaco are without a win in their last four Ligue 1 matches, two draws and two losses, and will look to bounce back against the newly promoted side.
 OneFootball Videos
 Paris Brunner is expected to keep his place, with Matthis Abline expected to join him after scoring off the bench in midweek.
 Only Stanis Idumbo and Ansu Fati are out injured for Les Monégasques, while Mika Biereth and Mohammed Salisu have not made the matchday squad on this occasion.
 Predicted Monaco XI v Le Mans: Lukas Hradecky, Nazinho, Eric Dier, Sadibou Sané, Vanderson, Aleksandr Golovin, Denis Zakaria, Lamine Camara, Edan Diop, Matthis Abline, Paris Brunner.
 Source: Get French Football News
